summary: Peace Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 6,000,000 units at $10.00/unit for gross proceeds of $60,000,000, along with a simultaneous private placement of 262,500 units at the same price raising $2,625,000. Each unit consists of one ordinary share, one right (for one-fifth ordinary share post-business combination), and one redeemable warrant (exercise price $11.50/share). The sponsor and underwriter purchased the private placement units, which are identical to IPO units and subject to transfer restrictions until a business combination. This is a routine IPO completion, not a special situation.
